title: Recreational Programming
summary: A presentation exploring the concept of recreational programming - programming as a hobby for enjoyment, creativity, and personal growth rather than for work or productivity. The content discusses why developers engage in side projects and the benefits of coding for fun.
problem_solved: Explores why programmers should maintain creative side projects and how recreational coding benefits personal development and career growth.
why_valuable: Highlights the importance of creative freedom in programming and encourages developers to view coding as an enjoyable hobby, not just a job.
